title: Expanding Whistleblower Protections for Contractors Act of 2025

claims.claim: Rewrites 10 U.S.C. 4701(a)(1) so a "protected individual" rather than an "employee" may not be discharged, demoted, or discriminated against for refusing to obey an unlawful order or disclosing gross mismanagement, gross waste, abuse of authority, or violation of law related to DoD or NASA contracts/subcontracts/grants/subgrants, or a substantial and specific danger to public health or safety

claims.sourceSpan: Gross mismanagement of any National Aeronautics and Space Administration contract or grant, any gross waste of Administration funds
claims.note: Structure: two subparagraphs (A),(B); (B) has clauses (i) DoD, (ii) NASA, (iii) danger — "three distinct activities" is a mild structural gloss

claims.claim: Adds a new definition of "protected individual" including contractors, subcontractors, grantees, subgrantees of DoD and NASA — including state/DC/tribal/PR/Guam/American Samoa/VI/N.
